purpose: Design the metadata boundary between visual source assets, debug-client visual fixtures, future production map object metadata, future collision/walkability metadata, future interaction metadata, and future server authority.
non_inference_rules: A wall sprite does not imply collision.
A door sprite does not imply open or close behavior.
A shop stall sprite does not imply shop inventory.
A bed sprite does not imply sleep behavior.
A sewer grate sprite does not imply travel or teleport behavior.
A roof overlay does not imply house ownership or entry.
An NPC-looking sprite does not imply a server NPC.
A creature-looking sprite does not imply a server mob.
A visual footprint does not imply walkability or blocking.

notes: Accepted as a metadata boundary design gate only.
Draft schemas remain design artifacts and are not promoted into shared runtime packages.
Production map promotion remains blocked pending separate visual fixture export, collision/walkability, door/house authority, and production map candidate gates.
Future schema validation should include negative fixtures proving that visual objects reject collision, walkability, shop, dialogue, spawn, AI, combat, ownership, and door-permission fields.

protected_files: house, ownership, access-list, shop, dialogue, faction, spawn, AI, or combat systems
notes: Draft schemas are design artifacts only and are not written to shared runtime packages.
Examples use real current visual asset ids but remain draft visual-only examples.
Production map promotion remains blocked pending separate metadata and authority gates.
